The '''Trid spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located at the eastern end of the town of [[Trid]], the capital of [[Danuta]], and was the gateway to and from the planet.

==Description==
The spaceport contained a humble, one-story terminal that didn't differ much from a common warehouse. At its west end was nestled a battery with [[surface-to-air missile]]s, and a farm of [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]]. To the other end was an off-limits area with six [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], guarded by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and many prohibition signs.<ref name="SE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

Adjacent to the terminal were [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], clubs, strip joints and cheap diners, as was the gase with most towns throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Up the street were the outfitters, suppliers, and parts houses.<ref name="SE" />

A small strip lane was available to the [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. An automated [[ground guide]], with worn-out orange paint, guided incoming vessels to their slot.<ref name="SE" />

Twenty meters beyond its security fence was a lodging establishment, suffering by the noise, vibrations and stenches coming from the spaceport; however according to its [[Unidentified Kubazian landlord|Kubazian landlord]], it provided a great view.<ref name="SE" />

==History==
The spaceport served [[Trid]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Danuta]], frequented by employees of [[Brodsport Mining Corporation]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and Imperials. Although not as busy as spaceports of larger cities of more important planets, five dozens of ships can come and go by the strip in one day.<ref name="SE" />

[[Kyle Katarn]] on his [[Mission to Danuta]], arrived on the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' and landed on slot twenty-three under the identity of "Dan Drexel". The local customs agent recognised his face, having seen it earlier in some briefing (Katarn was wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], having defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]), and was about to check; "Drexel" claimed that he was off shedule and would rather bribe the agent in order to let him pass without more delay.<ref name="SFTEad">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref> The ''Crow'' stayed there for several days, and Katarn used it as his home while preparing for his tasked with infiltrating the [[Danuta research facility]].<ref name="SE" />

Eventually Katarn reunited with fellow Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jan Ors]] and tasked her with piloting the ''Crow'' in order to extract him. While the customs agent discovered something suspicious about "Drexel" and was talking with several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] holding a paper (presumably a wanted poster for Katarn), they saw Ors about to board the ''Crow''; she managed to raise the ramp in time and boot up the system, while the soldiers in vain tried to harm the ship with their hand weapons, only to be cut by the ship's lasers. In the meantime [[TIE pilot]]s ran to the TIE fighters, who proved to be easy targets for her; one TIE managed to lift the ground and attempted to shoot at the ''Crow'' but Jan detonated a load of fuel, blowing the vessels. The resulting shrapnel, fuel and the cannon fire devastated the remaining pursuing ships. After the havoc, the ''Crow'' flew to the west to rendezvous with Katarn.<ref name="SE" />
